entities.name: Tyreus
entities.description: A Ravnican planeswalker, grandson of Sylvene, who secretly studied magic and planeswalked to the Forgotten Realms.

entities.name: Sylvene
entities.description: Tyreus's grandmother, who visited the Forgotten Realms and returned to Ravnica.

entities.name: Tyberio
entities.description: Son of Sylvene, father of Tyreus, who forbade magic.

entities.name: Ayraea
entities.description: Wife of Tyberio and mother of Tyreus.

entities.name: Forgotten Realms
entities.description: Setting visited by Sylvene and Tyreus.

events.summary: Sylvene falls in love in the Forgotten Realms and builds a demiplane refuge.
events.quote: She fell in love with a local man and built a refuge for them in a small demiplane of her creation

events.summary: Sylvene gives birth to Tyberio in Waterdeep, returns to Ravnica and dies when he is twelve.
events.quote: she passed away when Tyberio was twelve

events.summary: Tyberio forbids his son from studying magic, but Tyreus learns secretly; his parents die of plague.
events.quote: Tyberio and Ayraea passed away from a minor plague

events.summary: Tyreus devotes his life to magic and planeswalks to the Realms.
events.quote: He managed to planeswalk to the Realms in pursuit of legends and lore

relations.quote: He is the grandson of Sylvene .
Tyberio started a family with his wife, Ayraea
